macro_metrics.description: Balanced regression metrics. class_participant_macro (primary) weights every (participant, weight) cell equally, removing both the 0 kg majority bias and per-participant sample-count bias. R2 under class balancing uses class-balanced sample weights; participant_macro R2 averages within-participant R2.

modality_comparison.description: Repeated-measures ANOVA across modalities on per-participant class-macro metrics (each weight class weighted equally within a participant). Post-hoc: Bonferroni-corrected paired t-tests. Pairwise relations use '<' for p_adj < 0.05, '~' otherwise.
